notes.title: Major Content Update
notes.content: I have updated the game and requested it to be made free to play. New artwork added, story has been condensed, and new puzzles added and redistributed for Pacing reasons. Thank you to everyone for their support and help.

notes.title: Been a long time
notes.content: Unfortunately due to my own inadequacies in marketing and other areas of the sales of this game I've had to make some difficult decisions about the length and format of the game. It's primarily turned into a free mobile game, but despite that fact I still want to publish a port of that game at least. I can't unfortunately put a whole lot more time into a project that has ultimately been as unsuccessful as this one. That being said I do plan on delivering a finished product, even if it is severely abridged. Here are some of the screenshots of the new art, from the upcoming version.[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687039/d3047d8302c2cde1b3457156c91a94a4c97a78e7.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687039/8e938484700a01e0f9e0b04e1990d16d5200b1f1.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687039/9beedeefd8dc56352c9a4e15860264e0ebc376c9.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687039/848f8e5c0d8e568bbb86c09740175d3b5a6e50a0.jpg[/img]

notes.content:
A new build is live with various bug fixes and the addition of the latest hybrid puzzle. They don't seem to effect the way the game runs, but they can make the game difficult to play anyway.

notes.title: Indiegogo Campaign Launched
notes.content:
I've launch an Indiegogo campaign to help fund the development of this project. I wish I could just continue to do it all with any additional funds, but in order to complete the project in a timely manner I could use the funding.
     I have also created a much shorter demo in Android and windows format with 1/3 of the puzzles and 1/3 of the story content to use for the campaign. This demo will be static and not updated while the Early access version will be updated regularly with additional content and bug fixes at regular intervals.

Here is a link to the page.
https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/tessa-s-ark-early-access-funding-rpg/x/17100269#/

notes.title: A Fortunate Announcement
notes.content:
Update Notes:
The offending Music Has Been Removed and the framerate cap moved to 60 FPS. PC Master Race Rejoice! Hopefully the problem has been solved until I can get a proper sound designer. Let me know if any other problems occur.

Edit: To ensure you're able to monetize your coverage, go in to the options and mute the music before you Stream. The sound effects will still be audible. Sorry for the inconvenience this is causing, but I'm working every day to solve it.

notes.title: An Unfortunate Announcement
notes.content: It has come to my attention that copyright claims have been getting issued on coverage for this game on YouTube and Twitch. I have spoken with the company I obtained the music from, and while it is licensed correctly, the claims are automated and being made by third parties, and unfortunately neither I or AudioBlocks has any ability to intervene. So for now if you plan on streaming the game PLEASE mute your audio while I look into seeing in what ways I can fix this permanently. I would like to also apologize to any whose enjoyment of the game was hampered by this issue, and know that I both care and I am actively looking into fixing this.
